note: Explanations for the six rows of worked-corpus; `row` indexes that file. `expect` maps a claim type to [checkable, failed]; unlisted types must be [0, 0]. `planted` names the claim type a deliberate error targets.

items.name: true-claims
items.text: White plays gxh5, capturing the pawn on h5. The knight on g5 eyes f7, so Nxf7 is possible, and so is Bxg6.

items.name: true-check
items.text: Bc4+ gives check and is legal. White has two rooks and White is up a pawn.

items.name: true-material-and-squares
items.text: Material is equal. Black has two bishops and f1 is empty. The d4 pawn is white.

items.name: planted-piece-on-square
items.text: The queen on d4 controls the centre, while the knight on g5 is active.

items.name: planted-square-state
items.text: f1 is empty, but e5 is empty as well.

items.name: planted-illegal-move
items.text: I recommend Qh7 here, and e2e5 is also fine.

items.name: planted-check-phrase-on-committed-move
items.text: The move gives check and wins the initiative.

items.name: planted-capture-target
items.text: White is capturing the bishop on h5, and wins the pawn on e6.

items.name: planted-material
items.text: White has three rooks and White is up a knight.

items.name: planted-material-lead-wrong-side
items.text: Black is up a knight, but White is up a pawn.

items.name: hypothetical-is-unchecked-not-failed
items.text: If Black answers with Qxd5 the position opens. Then ...Nxe5 would fail.

items.name: no-checkable-claims
items.text: This is a sound developing move that improves the position.

items.name: castling-and-promotion-forms
items.text: O-O is legal here, but O-O-O is also legal.
